# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 9 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalent)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 1QH (Cave 1), Col. 9 | **Condition:** Better preserved

---

**9:1** I thank You, O Lord, for You have opened my ears to astonishing mysteries.

**9:2** And You have not closed them to the hard lessons of [...] the crises of this age.

**9:3** For mortal nature [...] caught up in wicked and rebellious deeds.

**9:4** I have held on tight to Your covenant. And the truth that [...] You have planted in my heart.

**9:5** And Your faithful love for the rescue of my soul, and You have made my steps secure.

**9:6** Against the rule of wickedness. And You have turned me into a trap for those who sin.

**9:7** But a source of healing for everyone who turns from wrongdoing, and good sense for those who lack it.

**9:8** And iron resolve for all whose hearts tremble. You have made me an insult and a joke to the deceitful.

**9:9** But a source of truth and understanding for those who walk the right path.

**9:10** Against the plots of the wicked I have become someone [...] mocked.

**9:11** Through me You have made the faces of the community shine; You have multiplied Yourself beyond all counting.

**9:12** For You have shown me Your astonishing mysteries.

**9:13** And through Your amazing hidden counsel You have demonstrated Your power through me.

**9:14** Performing miracles in front of the whole community for the sake of Your glory.

**9:15** And announcing Your powerful acts to every living creature.

**9:16** What is a mortal that You would do such things for them? And how could a being made of clay perform great wonders?

**9:17** For a person sits in wrongdoing from the moment of birth, and in guilty faithlessness right through to old age.

**9:18** And I know that no human being owns righteousness, and no mortal walks a flawless path.

**9:19** All righteous deeds belong to God Most High alone, and no person's path is secure.

**9:20** Unless the spirit God crafted for them makes their way straight for them.

**9:21** So that all God's creatures may recognize the force of God's power and the depth of God's mercy.

**9:22** Poured out on all whom God has chosen to favor.

**9:23** And shaking and dread took hold of me, and every bone in my body felt crushed.

**9:24** And my heart dissolved like wax next to a flame, and my knees gave out like water running downhill.

**9:25** For I remembered everything I had done wrong, along with the faithlessness of my ancestors.

**9:26** When the wicked attacked Your covenant and the debased turned against Your word.

**9:27** And I thought, because of my own rebellion I have been cut off from Your covenant.

**9:28** But then I recalled the strength of Your hand and the sheer depth of Your mercy.

**9:29** I got back on my feet and stood firm, and my spirit held its ground against the onslaught.

**9:30** For I anchored myself in Your covenant-faithfulness and in Your bottomless compassion.

**9:31** For You wipe away wrongdoing and purify people through Your own righteousness from [...] rebellion.

**9:32** Not for anyone's sake but for the sake of Your glory. For You shaped both the righteous and the wicked.

**9:33** And You set the direction of [...] spirit and the purpose of [...] from before the ages began.

**9:34** And the verdict on all and the task of [...] You distributed across every generation.

**9:35** Working wonders before the entire community for the sake of Your glory and proclaiming Your powerful acts.

**9:36** To every living thing, so that all may recognize Your power and the lavishness of Your mercy on everyone You have chosen.

**9:37** And I, Your servant, have learned through the spirit You gave me that every word You speak is truth, and every act of Yours is righteous.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 9 is the emotional and theological heart of the Hodayot. The speaker's journey — from thanksgiving to terror to recovery to confession — is a microcosm of the spiritual life. The devastating honesty of 9:17-18 makes the concluding faith statement (9:37) all the more powerful.*
